title: If you’ve ever wondered how Quel’Thalas was rebuilt, look no further 🌌

author: World of Warcraft
description:
Flip through charcoal drawings of Eversong Woods, walk through an in-progress Shepherd's Gate, see the instrument that brought the dooming sound of the Voidstorm, and more.  On this Building Azeroth, let the World of Warcraft dev team give you a behind-the-scenes look at how they completely rebuilt the elven kingdom of Quel'Thalas and its capital city Silvermoon.
